title: Battery Evidence Record — BER-0 Internal Schema
_architectureNote: INTERNAL SCHEMA ONLY. No production runtime may read this file in BER-0. This schema defines the minimal BER envelope for internal architecture purposes. It is not exposed publicly and does not drive any runtime behaviour in BER-0.
_nonGoals: BER storage from ordinary public finder use

recordMeta.description: BER record metadata. Identifies and dates this evidence record.

berId.description: Stable unique identifier for this Battery Evidence Record.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the BER schema this record conforms to.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was created.

lastModifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was last modified.

berStatus.description: Current status of this BER record.

identityRef.description: Reference to the canonical governed identity record. Does NOT copy the full identity record — reference only.

recordId.description: The recordId of the canonical governed identity record.

recordType.description: The record type from the governed identity record.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the canonical governed identity record.

claims.description: Governed evidence claims. Each claim describes a specific field with its evidence basis and source references.

claimId.description: Stable human-readable unique identifier for this claim.

fieldName.description: The name of the field this claim describes.

value.description: The claimed value. May be null if withheld or unknown.

evidenceBasis.description: HOW this claim was established. Separate from source authority (WHO). See evidenceBasis vocabulary.

sourceIds.description: Source identifiers from the canonical source register (data/source-register.json). Authority and rights must be resolved from the register, not copied into the claim.

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time when this claim was retrieved/recorded.

relationships.description: References to existing governed relationships. No charger/equipment functionality is implemented in BER-0.

regulatoryEvidence.description: Schema placeholder only. No recall matching engine is implemented in BER-0.

unknowns.description: Fields or claims for which evidence has not been established. Unknown cannot improve an outcome.

nextEvidenceRequest.description: Reserved for future use. Not implemented in BER-0.

conflicts.description: Fields where competing evidence values exist with no resolved winner.

eligibility.description: Eligibility reference/adaptation of existing governed eligibility concepts. Does not invent public eligibility semantics.

audit.description: Structural placeholder only. Full lifecycle history is not implemented in BER-0.
